Name: Logistics Pipes
Author: soggyCardbored
Description:
[b]Logistics Pipes[/b] adds directional item transport to Stardew Valley. Build pipe networks between chests, machines, crab pots, and trash cans to automate sorting, machine input/output, and everyday farm workflows.[b]Features[/b][list][*]5 pipe tiers with increasing throughput
[*]Directional routing for precise control over item flow[*]Smart chest filtering with item groups, seasons, and specific item filters[*]Allow mode and block mode for destination chests[*]Automatic machine loading and finished product collection[*]Crab pot baiting and catch collection[*]Trash can collection[*]Splitting across multiple destinations[*]Pipes can be placed on walls[*]NPCs can walk over pipes
[/list][b]How it works[/b]Pipes move items along directed routes between valid endpoints. You can connect:[list][*]Chest -> Chest[*]Chest -> Machine[*]Machine -> Chest[*]Trash Can -> Chest[*]Chest -> Crab Pot[*]Crab Pot -> Chest[/list]The flow rate of a route is determined by the lowest-tier pipe in the path.[b]Smart chest filters[/b]What destination chests can accept can be configured with:[list][*]Item groups[*]Season filters[*]Specific item filters[*]Allow mode or block mode[/list]Groups include:[list][*]Fruit, Vegetables, Flowers, Seeds, Forage, Fish[*]Animal Products, Artisan Goods, Mining, Fuel[*]Bait & Tackle, Monster Loot, Crafting Materials, Cooked Food[/list]Season filters can work by themselves or be combined with item groups. When a season filter is active, any non-seasonal items are blocked.[b]Visual tools[/b][list][*][b]P[/b] toggles pipe direction arrows[*][b]L[/b] toggles highlights for recognised route targets[/list]These are useful when building more complex networks or checking that a route is set up the way you expect.[b]Controls[/b][list][*][b]Left Click[/b] - Place pipe[*][b]R[/b] - Rotate pipe[*][b]O[/b] - Open chest filter menu[*][b]P[/b] - Toggle pipe arrows[*][b]L[/b] - Toggle highlights[*][b]F5[/b] - Manual route rescan. (should not need to use)[/list]All keybindings are configurable in config.json.﻿[b]Pipe replacement[/b]To make building easier, you do not need to break and replace pipes repeatedly. If you place a pipe onto an existing pipe, the new pipe's orientation and pipe type will be applied, and the old pipe will be returned to your inventory.[b]Placement note[/b]Pipes can also be placed on walls. Keep in mind that if you place a pipe more than 1 tile into a wall, you will not be able to reach it to break it later, though you can still change its direction by placing another pipe onto it like normal.[b]Installation[/b][list=1][*]Install SMAPI[*]Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder[*]Launch the game[/list][b]Notes[/b][list][*]Pipes only work within the current location[*]Machine-to-machine transfers are not supported[*]Routes are rescanned automatically and can also be refreshed manually with F5[/list][b]Feedback
[/b]If people want a short video walkthrough after release, I can put together a quick demo showing my setup and how I configure the filters.

Here is the git hub if interested
https://github.com/BrigBryu/Logistics-Pipes.git
